Create ONE new, finished mobile app UI screenshot for a Chinese shared bookkeeping system. Portrait 1024x2048, one flat full-screen artboard. The supplied picture is a STYLE REFERENCE only: ignore its black phone-gallery margins, collage layout, title and watermark; do not reproduce its diary app content.

Add small original calico cat, pink rabbit and blue mouse stickers sparingly; do not fill the entire UI with illustrations.
